law.backend_change_rule: A backend change ENDS the current experiment and mints a new run ID. No silent switching mid-experiment. Recorded as a run-ending event in the experiment header; the new run ID opens with the new backend recorded.
law.fallback_rule: Adapter failure raises; the experiment harness — never the model layer — decides whether to end the run and descend the ladder. Descending never ascends on its own: a rung change is always a new run ID.
law.rung5_mandatory: Every experiment claiming an architectural effect must include a rung-5 (deterministic symbolic baseline) run. If the loop's cognition vanishes under rung 5, the contribution was the foundation model, not the machinery.
